styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF planes crossed by soft pale grey #F2F3F1 diagonal light bands, plus flat pale grey #EDEFEC infographic panels and equal white #FFFFFF rounded cards
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, large front-left key with gentle fill, soft grey contact shadows, one clean edge highlight along the product, no harsh speculars

noDrift: no floating product without a contact shadow
no cloud-shaped or gradient-heavy decorative motifs
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean fresh skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, pale grey white #F2F3F1 light fields, charcoal text #26282A and one lime-green accent #8CC63F; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with a thin #8CC63F underline bar; consistent thin-line charcoal #4A4D4A icons inside thin #8CC63F outlined circles; consistent rounded white label shapes and bubble-tail pointer labels; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright product scale and placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no floating product without a contact shadow.
